notes.title: Major Patch - Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content: Enhancements and bug fixes brought across from sequel back into original

notes.title: Update/Bug Fixes/Enhancements
notes.content:
A major update for Knights of Grumthorr has been released.

Includes important changes to scripting environment (text files) that allow for more flexible modding, and improved capabilities.

Changes to game graphical memory management to allow a greater number of units and graphics in the game.

Dark Invasion Mod now included (activated by changing media/txt/init.txt file - one line)

notes.title: 5-Mar-2021 Major Update
notes.content:
1.Dark Invasion Mod included in download
2.Additional scripting features (txt file changes)
3.Enhancements to Memory Management (more units possible now)
